title: FireLab engine vs Random and Monkey: Firefly Lake and Deep Quest

firefly.name: Firefly Lake (three.js arcade game, 5 seeded bugs)
firefly.notes: three.js loads from jsDelivr: the machine needs internet access.

bugs.what: menu drawn in 2 columns: ▲▼ ignore the layout and a "Credits" cell is unreachable
after visiting Quality, ▲▼ cycle 3 items and Back does nothing (focus trap)
◀ on Quality after ▶ throws a TypeError
OK within 300 ms of Resume blanks the screen
after the 2nd lantern the render loop stops

deep-quest.name: Deep Quest (TV RPG with nested dialogs and a 30-floor dungeon, 6 seeded bugs)

bugs.what: Options › Video › High › Apply, then Controls › Remap › OK throws
buying the Key, then resting at the inn blanks the screen
saving to slot 3 twice traps the focus (Back does nothing)
taking the floor-10 chest's loot while carrying the Key throws
the middle door on floor 20 stops the render loop
defending three times against the floor-30 boss throws on every frame
